title: The Spectre #2 DC Comics 2001 Hal Jordan J.M. DeMatteis Ryan Sook Cover
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Spectre #2 (Apr 2001), DC Comics - the 2001 series with Hal Jordan as the Spectre. Written by J.M. DeMatteis, art and cover by Ryan Sook. Ryan Sook cover of the Spectre (Hal Jordan) before gears and chains. Original $2.50 cover price.

Back cover: Bose Wave radio/CD ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
